hints.title: Distinct Value Independence
hints.text: For three indices to form an unequal triplet, all three corresponding array values must be mutually distinct.

hints.title: Frequency Grouping
hints.text: Count the frequency of each distinct value in the array.

hints.title: Combinatorial Contribution
hints.text: For a distinct element with frequency c, if there are left elements strictly preceding its group and right elements strictly following it, it contributes left * c * right triplets.

hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Combinatorics Implementation
hints.text:
```python
from collections import Counter

class Solution:
    def unequalTriplets(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        freq = Counter(nums)
        vals = list(freq.values())
        ans = 0
        left = 0
        n = len(nums)
        for c in vals:
            right = n - left - c
            ans += left * c * right
            left += c
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Single pass frequency collection followed by linear pass over unique keys.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force testing of all three nested index loops takes cubic O(n^3) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(u) auxiliary memory to index counts of distinct numbers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Aggregates frequencies to compute combinations in linear time instead of cubic simulation.
